fusions.name: Chaff Cloud
fusions.desc: Your hooves kick up 3 bursts of chaff at once, spread apart, each dealing 10 damage. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Strip to the Stalk
fusions.desc: Flings a biting knot of locusts from your hooves at the first enemy in line, dealing 8 damage and healing you for 20% of it. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Following Swarm
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a swarm that runs with you for 12 seconds, biting an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second. It draws the attention of the last enemy you struck, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Eat and Move On
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, 20% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
